name: Secure Media Destruction Schedule
prompt:
Read page 4 of Secure_Media_Destruction/涉密介质销毁规程_V3.1.pptx on the desktop. That page has a flowchart in which rectangular and diamond nodes are connected in series by arrowed connector lines. Determine the sequence of the nodes based on the arrow directions, extract the text in each rectangle and diamond, and generate an .ics calendar schedule file in that order, saved to Secure_Media_Destruction/Destruction_Task_Chain.ics on the desktop. Ignore the other pages.

Scheduling rules: the first task starts at 8 a.m. on November 1, 2024. Rectangular nodes represent regular operations, from 8:00 to 17:00 that day, 9 hours in total; diamond nodes represent review and confirmation, from 8:00 to 12:00 that day, 4 hours in total. After each task is completed, the next task starts at 8 a.m. the next day, scheduled on consecutive calendar days without skipping weekends. Prefix the title of every calendar event with “[保密任务-XD24] ”.
